import PV_L2C_ChunkShape
import PV_L2C_AbsorbRange
import PV_L2C_HashRange
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_HashTotal
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R1Z R0Z.WriterRefine
open BuilderForestStdPort BuilderForestAdmissionPort PV_Src_PortSboxStep
local instance : ExternalLinear := PV_Src_ExternalReference.dictionary
local instance : Fact (Nat.Prime 2147483647) := ⟨R0Z.m31_prime⟩
abbrev callback := PV_L2C_HashLoopRange.callback

/-- The planner's bounded hash calls need no source-success premise. The
entire actual absorb/permutation/chunk-loop Result is successful. -/
theorem loop (i : PV_L2C_ChunkStep.Iter) (hs : i.iter.size = 8)
    (hb : i.count.val+i.iter.remaining.val.length ≤ 20)
    (hx : ∀ x ∈ i.iter.remaining.val, x.val < 2147483647)
    (s : State) (hc : Canonical s) :
    ∃ out, poseidon2.hash_fields_with_trace_loop0 callback i () s = ok out ∧ Canonical out := by
  generalize he : i.iter.remaining.val.length = n
  induction n using Nat.strong_induction_on generalizing i s with
  | h n ih =>
    by_cases empty : i.iter.remaining.val = []
    · refine ⟨s,?_,hc⟩
      have hn := PV_L2C_ChunkShape.done i empty
      unfold PV_L2C_ChunkStep.next at hn
      rw [poseidon2.hash_fields_with_trace_loop0.eq_1,hn]
      rfl
    · have count : i.count.val < 24 := by omega
      have next := PV_L2C_ChunkShape.step i hs empty count
      unfold PV_L2C_ChunkStep.next at next
      obtain ⟨absorbed,ha,hca⟩ := PV_L2C_AbsorbRange.entry
        (PV_L2C_ChunkShape.head i.iter.remaining) (PV_L2C_ChunkShape.head_length _)
        (PV_L2C_ChunkShape.head_canonical _ hx) s hc
      obtain ⟨expected,hperm,hcan,_⟩ :=
        PV_RunJoin_HashCallback17.permutation (K := ZMod 2147483647) i.count absorbed
      obtain ⟨out,ho,hout⟩ := ih
        (PV_L2C_ChunkShape.advance i).iter.remaining.val.length
        (by have hlt := PV_L2C_ChunkShape.tail_shorter i.iter.remaining empty; exact he ▸ hlt)
        (PV_L2C_ChunkShape.advance i) rfl (PV_L2C_ChunkShape.advance_bound i hb empty)
        (PV_L2C_ChunkShape.tail_canonical _ hx) expected hcan rfl
      refine ⟨out,?_,hout⟩
      rw [poseidon2.hash_fields_with_trace_loop0.eq_1,next]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok,core.slice.Slice.iter,
        core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.trait_default,
        core.iter.traits.iterator.Iterator.enumerate.default]
      rw [ha]
      simp only [bind_tc_ok]
      rw [hperm]
      exact ho
#print axioms loop

theorem source (domain : U32) (input : Slice U32) (hd : domain.val < 2147483647)
    (hl : input.val.length ≤ 20) (hne : input.val ≠ [])
    (hx : ∀ x ∈ input.val, x.val < 2147483647) :
    ∃ d, poseidon2.hash_fields domain input = ok d ∧ Canon8 d := by
  obtain ⟨s,hs,hcan⟩ := loop ⟨⟨input,8⟩,0#usize⟩ rfl (by simpa using hl) hx
    (PV_L2C_HashRange.initial domain input)
    (PV_L2C_HashRange.initial_canonical domain input hd (by omega))
  refine ⟨digest8 s,?_,?_⟩
  · rw [PV_L2C_HashRange.shape domain input hne,hs]
    rfl
  · intro j hj
    rw [digest8_get s j hj]
    exact hcan ⟨j,by omega⟩
#print axioms source
end PV_L2C_HashTotal

import PV_L2C_HashTotal
import PV_L2C_DigestOrigin
import R1Z.BuilderAdmissionCanonical
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_PlannerOutputs
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R1Z R0Z.WriterRefine BuilderForestAdmissionPort
local instance : ExternalLinear := PV_Src_ExternalReference.dictionary

/-- Release-width seed arithmetic followed by the planner's final `% P`.
All bounds below hold even when the seed additions wrap. -/
def prior (seed : U32) (j : Fin 8) : U32 :=
  ⟨seed.bv + BitVec.ofNat 32 17 * BitVec.ofNat 32 j.val + BitVec.ofNat 32 1⟩
def generated (seed : U32) : Array U32 8#usize :=
  arr8 (fun j => PV_L2C_GeneratedRange.remainder (prior seed j))

theorem generated_origin (seed : U32) : PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin (generated seed) := by
  apply PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin.generated (prior seed)
  intro j
  exact arr8_get _ j.val j.isLt
#print axioms generated_origin

theorem generated_range (seed : U32) : Canon8 (generated seed) :=
  PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.canonical _ (generated_origin seed)
#print axioms generated_range

/-- Source wrapper cut of derive_owner_key: owner domain and exactly the
eight generated key words. Native wrapper binding is recorded separately. -/
def owner (seed : U32) : Result (Array U32 8#usize) :=
  poseidon2.hash_fields 1095958529#u32 (Array.to_slice (generated seed))

theorem owner_total (seed : U32) :
    ∃ key, owner seed = ok key ∧ PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin key := by
  have len : (Array.to_slice (generated seed)).val.length = 8 := by
    simpa only [Array.to_slice,UScalar.ofNatCore_val_eq] using (generated seed).property
  have hx : ∀ x ∈ (Array.to_slice (generated seed)).val, x.val < 2147483647 :=
    (BuilderAdmissionCanonical.canon_iff_list _).mp (generated_range seed)
  have nonempty : (Array.to_slice (generated seed)).val ≠ [] := by
    intro he;rw [he] at len;cases len
  obtain ⟨key,hkey,_⟩ := PV_L2C_HashTotal.source 1095958529#u32
    (Array.to_slice (generated seed)) (by scalar_tac) (by rw [len];omega) nonempty hx
  exact ⟨key,hkey,.hashed 1095958529#u32 _ (by scalar_tac) (by rw [len];omega) nonempty hkey⟩
#print axioms owner_total

theorem outputs (n : U32) :
    ∃ recipient change,
      owner 300#u32 = ok recipient ∧
      owner (U32.wrapping_add 500#u32 n) = ok change ∧
      PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin recipient ∧ PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin change ∧
      PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin (generated 400#u32) ∧
      PV_L2C_DigestOrigin.Origin (generated (U32.wrapping_add 600#u32 n)) := by
  obtain ⟨recipient,hr,hor⟩ := owner_total 300#u32
  obtain ⟨change,hc,hoc⟩ := owner_total (U32.wrapping_add 500#u32 n)
  exact ⟨recipient,change,hr,hc,hor,hoc,generated_origin _,generated_origin _⟩
#print axioms outputs
end PV_L2C_PlannerOutputs

import PV_L2C_CanonicalCaller
import R0Z.PoseidonCanon
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_BlockRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine

def Canonical {n : Usize} (a : Array U32 n) : Prop :=
  ∀ k, k < n.val → (a.val[k]!).val < 2147483647

theorem zeros (n : Usize) : Canonical (Array.repeat n 0#u32) := by
  intro k hk
  rw [Array.repeat_val,List.getElem!_eq_getElem?_getD,List.getElem?_replicate,if_pos hk]
  change 0 < 2147483647
  omega
#print axioms zeros

theorem fallback {n : Usize} (r : Result (Array U32 n)) (d : Array U32 n)
    (hd : Canonical d) (hr : ∀ out, r = ok out → Canonical out) :
    Canonical (okOr r d) := by
  cases r <;> first | exact hr _ rfl | exact hd
#print axioms fallback

/-- Exact raw cell bounds of the extracted block writer, before projection
to a field. The pre-state and absorption cells are included. -/
theorem block (pre ab : Array U32 16#usize)
    (rounds : Array (Array U32 16#usize) 11#usize) (b : Array U32 256#usize)
    (hp : Canonical pre) (ha : Canonical ab)
    (hr : R0PoseidonCopy.perm_rounds pre ab = ok rounds)
    (hb : R0BlockCopies.write_block pre ab rounds = ok b) : Canonical b := by
  obtain ⟨expected,he,hcells⟩ := block_spec pre ab rounds
  have same : b = expected := Result.ok.inj (hb.symm.trans he)
  intro k hk
  rw [same,hcells]
  unfold BlockVal
  split_ifs with hpre hround hab
  · exact hp k (by simpa using hpre)
  · exact R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_canon pre ab rounds hr (k/16-1)
      (by omega) (k%16) (by omega)
  · exact ha (k-192) (by simp;omega)
  · change 0 < 2147483647
    omega
#print axioms block

theorem digest (pre ab : Array U32 16#usize) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (h : blockDigestR pre ab = ok d) : Canon8 d := by
  unfold blockDigestR at h
  pv_peel h with rounds hr
  cases h
  intro j hj
  rw [digest8_get _ j hj]
  exact R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_canon pre ab rounds hr 10 (by omega) j (by omega)
#print axioms digest

theorem sponge_digest (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize)
    (len : Usize) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (h : spongeDigestR pre chunk len = ok d) : Canon8 d := by
  unfold spongeDigestR at h
  pv_peel h with ab hab
  exact digest pre ab d h
#print axioms sponge_digest

theorem node_digest (left right d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (h : nodeDigestR left right = ok d) : Canon8 d := by
  unfold nodeDigestR at h
  pv_peel h with pre hp
  pv_peel h with ab ha
  exact digest pre ab d h
#print axioms node_digest

theorem sponge_step (pre : Array U32 16#usize) (chunk : Array U32 8#usize)
    (len : Usize) (s : Array U32 16#usize)
    (h : spongeStep pre chunk len = ok s) : Canonical s := by
  unfold spongeStep at h
  pv_peel h with ab ha
  pv_peel h with rounds hr
  cases h
  intro j hj
  exact R0Z.PoseidonRefine.perm_canon pre ab rounds hr 10 (by omega) j
    (by simpa using hj)
#print axioms sponge_step
end PV_L2C_BlockRange

import PV_L2C_BlockRange
set_option autoImplicit false
namespace PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange
open Aeneas Aeneas.Std Result R0Z.WriterRefine

theorem fallback (r : Result (Array U32 8#usize))
    (hr : ∀ d, r = ok d → Canon8 d) : Canon8 (okOr r zero8) := by
  have hz : PV_L2C_BlockRange.Canonical zero8 := by
    intro j hj;exact zero8_canon j (by simpa using hj)
  have hc := PV_L2C_BlockRange.fallback r zero8 hz (fun d hd j hj =>
    hr d hd j (by simpa using hj))
  intro j hj
  exact hc j (by simpa using hj)
#print axioms fallback

theorem owner (w : RustWitness) (d : Array U32 8#usize) (h : ownerD w = ok d) :
    Canon8 d := by
  unfold ownerD at h
  pv_peel h with pre hp
  exact PV_L2C_BlockRange.sponge_digest pre w.sk 8#usize d h
#print axioms owner

theorem note (chunks : RustChunks) (block : Nat) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (h : noteDigestR chunks block = ok d) : Canon8 d := by
  unfold noteDigestR at h
  pv_peel h with pre hp
  exact PV_L2C_BlockRange.sponge_digest pre (chunks.schunk block) (chunks.sclen block) d h
#print axioms note

/-- The raw output of every computed path digest is canonical even before
assuming raw canonicality of the absorption cells recorded elsewhere. -/
theorem tree (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic) (n : Nat) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (h : treeCurR w p n = ok d) : Canon8 d := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact note (chunksOf w p) 3 d h
  | succ n =>
    rw [treeCurR] at h
    pv_peel h with current hc
    exact PV_L2C_BlockRange.node_digest _ _ d h
#print axioms tree

theorem output_pair (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (h : outPairR w p = ok d) : Canon8 d := by
  unfold outPairR at h
  cases hv : p.variant with
  | privateTransfer =>
    rw [hv] at h
    pv_peel h with recipient hr
    pv_peel h with change hc
    exact PV_L2C_BlockRange.node_digest recipient change d h
  | withdrawal =>
    rw [hv] at h
    pv_peel h with change hc
    exact PV_L2C_BlockRange.node_digest change zero8 d h
#print axioms output_pair

theorem append (w : RustWitness) (p : RustPublic) (n : Nat) (d : Array U32 8#usize)
    (h : appCurR w p n = ok d) : Canon8 d := by
  cases n with
  | zero => exact output_pair w p d h
  | succ n =>
    rw [appCurR] at h
    pv_peel h with current hc
    exact PV_L2C_BlockRange.node_digest _ _ d h
#print axioms append
end PV_L2C_ComputedDigestRange
